technical_and_design_decisions: The software increment is interpreted as a release-style update to Spring Cloud Data Flow (SCDF), which is the successor of Spring XD. The user stories (U1–U8) are treated as a single coherent increment tied to a particular release.
For U1 (Lattice 0.6.0 upgrade), the work is treated as a dependency/configuration upgrade plus verification, not a re-architecting of the runtime. Compatible configuration updates are assumed.

For U2 and U3 (rebranding and terminology), the work is treated as a search-and-replace plus documentation sweep, since most references are user-facing strings and docs; no public API or class names are assumed to be renamed to avoid breaking consumers.

For U4 (consistent look and feel), the work is scoped to a shared CSS/theme tokens layer (variables, typography, colors) consumed by both admin-ui (Angular) and flo (DSL editor). No full redesign is assumed.
For U5 (version and SPI type in about), the feature is implemented as a small backend endpoint plus UI rendering in the existing 'About' dialog.
For U6 (Flo Graph screenshots), the work is documentation-only: generating/exporting the existing DSL graphs as static images and embedding them in the batch DSL reference.
For U7 (design review), the deliverable is a written design assessment document with identified limitations and gaps; no implementation of remediation is in scope.

For U8 (shell commands to scale up/down a module), the implementation follows the existing shell command plugin pattern in SCDF, wrapping the underlying SPI scale operations so the user does not need SPI-specific CLIs.
All estimates assume one developer working full-time, with an 8-hour workday, in an existing well-understood codebase.
assumptions: The target project is Spring Cloud Data Flow (SCDF) with its admin-ui and flo components; Lattice is the local runtime used for demos.
The developer is already familiar with the SCDF codebase, its build system (Maven/Gradle), and its UI frameworks (Angular for admin-ui, d3-based flo).
No migration of persisted data or breaking API changes is required for U1, U2, or U3; only references (strings, labels, docs) are updated.
The Lattice 0.6.0 API is backward-compatible with the version currently used by SCDF in this increment; only configuration and version bumps are needed.
Screenshots for U6 are generated from the existing flo rendering using headless browser capture, not by manually drawing diagrams.

The shell command feature in U8 is implemented as a generic dispatcher that delegates to existing SPI scale operations, so only one new command per direction (scale-up, scale-down) per module needs to be added.
No new infrastructure, CI/CD changes, or third-party license review is required for this increment.
A small buffer for code review and minor rework is included in the testing/integration activity rather than as a separate activity.

activities.activity_description: Study the existing SCDF design, identify known limitations and gaps, and produce a written design assessment document covering admin-ui, flo, shell, and runtime concerns.
Update Lattice dependencies and configuration in the project, verify demo data flow on the new runtime, and fix any minor compatibility issues surfaced by the upgrade.

activities.activity_name: Replace Spring XD references with Spring Cloud Data Flow (U2)
activities.activity_description: Perform a codebase-wide search-and-replace of 'Spring XD' with 'Spring Cloud Data Flow' in source, configuration, UI strings, and documentation; verify no broken links or outdated references remain.
Update user-facing labels, documentation, and any non-API identifiers that use 'Job' to use 'Task' terminology consistent with the SCDF task domain model.

activities.activity_name: Unify look and feel of admin-ui and flo (U4)
activities.activity_description: Define a shared theme (color palette, typography, spacing, component styles) and apply it across admin-ui and flo so both surfaces present a consistent visual identity.

activities.activity_name: Add version and SPI type to About section (U5)
activities.activity_description: Expose admin-ui build version and SPI type via a backend info endpoint and render both fields in the existing About dialog of the UI.

activities.activity_name: Add Flo Graph screenshots to batch DSL docs (U6)
activities.activity_description: Generate representative Flo Graph images for the batch DSL reference documentation and embed them inline so readers can visually relate DSL constructs to flo graphs.

activities.activity_name: Implement direct shell commands for module instance scaling (U8)
activities.activity_description: Add new SCDF shell commands to scale a given module instance up or down, delegating to existing SPI scale operations; update shell help and inline docs.

Run unit and integration tests across the increment: verify Lattice 0.6.0 demo, rebranding/terminology consistency, UI rendering on both admin-ui and flo, About section values, and new shell scale commands end-to-end.

activities.activity_name: Release notes and final documentation pass
activities.activity_description: Update release notes summarizing the Lattice upgrade, rebranding, terminology changes, UI unification, About section, doc screenshots, design review, and new shell commands; perform a final documentation review.
